Pablo Sandoval

Positions: Third Baseman and First Baseman

Bats: Both  •  Throws: Right

Born: August 11, 1986 in Puerto Cabello, Venezuela ve

Debut: August 14, 2008 (Age 22-003d, 19,336th in major league history)

Agents: Beverly Hills Sports Council • Previously: SPS Sports Group

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Pablo Sandoval?

Pablo Sandoval is 39 years old.

When was Pablo Sandoval born?

Pablo Sandoval was born on August 11, 1986.

Where was Pablo Sandoval born?

Pablo Sandoval was born in Puerto Cabello, Venezuela.

How tall is Pablo Sandoval?

Pablo Sandoval is 5-10 (178 cm) tall.

How much did Pablo Sandoval weigh when playing?

Pablo Sandoval weighed 268 lbs (121 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Pablo Sandoval play?

Pablo Sandoval played 14 seasons.

Is Pablo Sandoval in the Hall of Fame?

Pablo Sandoval has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

What position did Pablo Sandoval play?

Pablo Sandoval was a Third Baseman and First Baseman.

How many hits did Pablo Sandoval have?

Pablo Sandoval had 1,279 hits over his career.

How many home runs did Pablo Sandoval have?

Pablo Sandoval had 153 home runs over his career.

What was Pablo Sandoval's average?

Pablo Sandoval had a .278 average over his career.

How many teams has Pablo Sandoval played for?

Pablo Sandoval played for 3 teams; the Atlanta Braves, Boston Red Sox and San Francisco Giants.

How many World Series has Pablo Sandoval won?

Pablo Sandoval has won 3 World Series.

When did Pablo Sandoval retire?

Pablo Sandoval last played in 2021.

What are Pablo Sandoval's nicknames?

Kung Fu Panda,Round Mound of Pound,Little Money are nicknames for Pablo Sandoval.
